question: Where can I locate gallery within 110 kilometers when heading toward Stransky Nature Trails, Warren Township, NJ starting at Salus University, Elkins Park, PA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Salus University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Elkins Park%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point_candidate_parks AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Stransky Nature Trails%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point_candidate_pois AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stransky Nature Trails%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Warren Township%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT geometry FROM end_point_candidate_parks), (SELECT geometry FROM end_point_candidate_pois) ) AS geometry ), target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)) AS azimuth_deg FROM start_point sp, end_point ep WHERE sp.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ep.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_azimuth_calc tac WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography, 110000) -- 110 kilometers in meters AND ( -- Calculate the shortest angular difference between the target azimuth and the azimuth to the POI -- and check if it's within +/- 45 degrees (a 90-degree cone) ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tac.azimuth_deg + 180) % 360 - 180 ) BETWEEN -45 AND 45;
